id.description: The saved object ID of the cloud onboarding deployment.

agentPolicyIds.description: Agent policy IDs for agent_based deployments. Single-element for new-policy deploys; multiple for existing-policy deploys targeting several policies.

attemptCount.description: Incremented by callers performing a retry.

authMethod.description: Authentication method. Refreshed on each successful deploy so a credential-method change between deploys is reflected on resume.

deploymentId.description: CFN stack ARN (or equivalent); provided by the client after manual deployment.

templateVersion.description: ECF semantic version resolved at launch time, e.g. "1.10.0".

ecfStacks.description: ECF CloudFormation stacks to record for this deployment.

mechanisms.description: Delivery mechanisms active in this deployment. Replaces the stored mechanisms array.

packagePolicyIds.description: Package policy IDs created for this deployment (managed_integration and agent_based).

services.description: Current service set for this deployment. Refreshed on each successful deploy so resume after an incremental service addition restores all deployed services.

serviceVars.description: Per-service config keyed by instance ID.

statusMessage.description: Error context; set when transitioning to failed.
